controls.name: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Manage technical vulnerabilities and take appropriate measures to address them.

controls.name: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Define and implement appropriate rules for the use of cryptography.

controls.name: Access control
controls.description: Establish and implement rules for controlling physical and logical access.

controls.name: Logging
controls.description: Produce, store, protect, and analyze appropriate logs.

controls.name: Data protection by design and by default
controls.description: Implement appropriate data protection measures by design and by default where applicable.

controls.name: Security of processing
controls.description: Implement security measures appropriate to the risk, considering the applicable requirements.

Technical Vulnerabilities.recommendation: Assess the vulnerability, apply appropriate security updates, and verify that the weakness has been resolved.

Cryptography and Encryption.recommendation: Evaluate the sensitivity of the data and implement appropriate encryption and key-management measures.

Access Control.recommendation: Review access permissions, enforce least privilege, and verify that access is limited to authorized users.

Authentication.recommendation: Review authentication practices and implement appropriate protections for authentication information.

Logging.recommendation: Review logging requirements and implement appropriate event logging, protection, and monitoring.
